## Before you begin

- A Grafana Cloud account. [Create an account](https://grafana.com/signup/cloud/connect-account) if you need one.
- Grafana Assistant enabled on your stack. If it isn't enabled yet, [Get started with Grafana Assistant](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/get-started-grafana-assistant/) shows how.
- At least one Prometheus, Loki, or BigQuery data source with telemetry for a real service. Calibration must save at least one validated query, and queries that return no data can stop it.
- Watchers permissions: `grafana-assistant-app.watcher-agents:read` to view, `:create` and `:write` together to create a watcher (creating also starts calibration), `:write` to calibrate, start, and pause, `:create` to run once, and `:delete` to delete. You also need `plugins.app:access` for the Assistant plugin.

You can only add data sources you're allowed to query. Watcher runs then query them as the stack's Assistant service account, so a watcher keeps running if its creator leaves the organization.

For full setup details, refer to [Use Assistant Watchers](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/platform/grafana-assistant/platform/watchers/).
